runtime_contract: Existing application behavior is preserved; no live external writes are used as verification.
hosted_protection: Required PR and strict GitHub Actions standards-gate, including administrators; no force push/deletion.
conformance: Not full conformance; unresolved controls remain in docs/audit.md.

performance.environment: Windows; CPython 3.12.16; synthetic offline data; same machine; five alternating base/candidate rounds.
performance.gate: Median across five rounds of both median and p95 latency must be <= base * 1.20 + 2 milliseconds. Response-contract hashes must match.

payload_budget.gate: No route exceeds 5% plus 1KiB gzip growth.

diagnostic_limit: An initial concurrent in-process TestClient run exceeded health/demo p95 limits. Separate local Uvicorn/HTTPX runs passed the same timing gate. This is representative local serving evidence, not a production load or reliability certification.
generated_updates: Existing generators retain their inputs, selected outputs and validation. Generated output uses unique automation branches, an explicitly dispatched engineering workflow and checked squash auto-merge. Both repositories default workflow tokens to read; only update workflows request contents/pull-requests/actions write. GitHub workflow PR creation and repository auto-merge are enabled; no workflow approves reviews.
automation_tests: Four offline Bash control-flow regressions: unchanged output, unique branch + gate + auto-merge, diff failure and commit failure. No GitHub writes are performed by those tests.
